title: Binary supervenience from unary supervenience on arbitrary ternary frames
scope: On arbitrary ternary frames every formula of the language with two determining inputs is equivalent to one with a single determining input (guard G(A,B)=D1(A; A and B) on the four Boolean cells), so Fan Conjecture 15 (strict hierarchy) fails at n=1; the Section 7.3 relativized agreement is definable; Humberstone 2019 pp. 16-17 undefinability assertion is corrected.
source_targets: Jie Fan, arXiv:1611.04740 Conjecture 15 and Section 7.3; Notre Dame J. Formal Logic 60(2) (2019) 283-309
Humberstone, Logic and Logical Philosophy 28 (2019) 3-135, pp. 16-17
substantive_reason: The guard-definability bridge resolves a source conjecture and a second source undefinability conjecture, and corrects an explicit published specialist claim (Humberstone 2019); the Boolean-cell technique itself is credited to the source and Goranko-Kuusisto.
novelty_standard: Qualified bounded comparison; specialist literature asserts the opposite; not worldwide priority
remaining_literature_limits: Yang/Vaananen, Ciardelli thesis, older Humberstone works not exhaustively covered
